row.evidence: Autotask's help documents only OpenID Connect single sign-on, where each user's 'Unique ID from their account with the identity provider' is entered on an existing resource; no SCIM or IdP provisioning topic exists in its help or developer-help sitemaps.
row.notes: New row (Autotask PSA, a Kaseya/Datto product; autotask.com redirects to datto.com). No SCIM (absence, medium): the Autotask help sitemap (4,703 topics), developer help sitemap and REST API reference contain no SCIM; SSO is OpenID Connect (Okta, Entra ID, Auth0 guides) and needs users to exist first, with no JIT documented. The REST Resources entity cannot create or delete users (query and update only); resources can only be inactivated, and activating one may add licence fees. Resource import (CSV template) creates users. Pricing is not public: the Datto product page offers 'Request Pricing'. Okta's OIN Autotask app is SWA only. KaseyaOne Unified Login is an alternative sign-in.

plans.name: Autotask PSA
plans.notes: No public tier table. SSO (OIDC) or 2FA is mandatory for all customers.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found: the Autotask online help sitemap (4,703 topics) and the developer help sitemap list no SCIM or user-provisioning topic; SSO is OpenID Connect and requires each resource to already exist in Autotask (custom autotaskuser attribute or per-resource Unique ID).

capabilities.notes: Resources entity supported request types: Can Create false, Can Delete false, Can Query true, Can Update true* (API user needs admin access to Resources/Users (HR)). Resources have an isActive field, but the docs do not say whether the API can change it.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Resources entity table marks 'Supports webhooks' true; event names not listed on that page.

rate_limits.text: 10,000 calls per hour per database; thread limit of three per object endpoint and tracking identifier for integrations built after 2023.1.

limitations.text: Resources (users) cannot be created or deleted through the REST API.
Resources can never be deleted, only inactivated.

user_api.notes: REST and SOAP APIs; the help says API docs 'should be used only by authorized Datto partners' but the developer help is public. API-only users carry no per-seat charge. No public plan list, so the plan with API access is not stated.

okta.notes: OIN Autotask app shows only SWA checked (password vaulting). Autotask documents a custom Okta OIDC app for SSO.

entra.notes: Autotask documents OIDC SSO with Azure AD / Entra ID via a customer app; Microsoft Learn autotask-tutorial returned 404.
